notes:
Snow Cut 0.1.2: the first release with the Windows desktop app alongside the Android build, so both update from here.

- Windows: SnowCut_0.1.2_x64-setup.exe installs Snow Cut for the current user. Installed copies check this repository once per launch and update from About, on Your cuts.
- Android: a debug-signed dev build for sideloading; it installs over 0.1.1, and 0.1.1's in-app updater picks it up.

No app changes since 0.1.1 beyond the version. Built from the local skicut repository (it has no GitHub remote).
